A favorite among peddlers and travelers alike.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== A Traveler's Bridle is a [[Bridle]] and a piece of [[Horse Gear]]. It has a chance to appear in a pair of [[Treasure Chest]] that spawn when the [[Link]] (Rider) [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. One Treasure Chest will contain the Traveler's Bridle, while the other Chest will contain the [[Traveler's Saddle]]. Once obtained, the Traveler's Bridle will appear in Link's [[Key Item]] [[Inventory]]. Link can have it equipped on his Horses by speaking to specific workers at [[Highland Stable]], [[Outskirt Stable]], [[South Akkala Stable]], and [[Woodland Stable]].{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Traveler's Bridle}}?|Canni|BotW}} However, they are unable to be equipped onto [[Epona]] or the [[Giant Horse]].{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out her {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? Actually, this horse is different from any I've ever seen before. My, she's so lovely and graceful... I'm sorry, but I'm pretty sure this little lady would absolutely hate it if you changed her mane or gear. I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}}{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out its {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? My goodness, that's no pony, is it? It's so big! I'm sorry, but I don't think I have any {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} that'd fit such a large horse, and I bet it wouldn't like its {{Color BotW|Blue|mane}} handled... I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}} Though its design does not stand out, it is favored among peddlers and travelers for suiting any type of Horse. In his [[Memory|Recovered Memories]], Link is shown to have a Traveler's Bridle and Traveler's Saddle equipped to his Horse before the second [[Great Calamity]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bridle * Horse Gear * Traveler's Saddle }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bridles, Horse Gear, Traveler's Gear |items= BotW, TotK |key-items= BotW, TotK }}
